meta.descricao: Game studio founded in 2024. Original games, social impact projects and custom software development.

hero.titulo: Games with a flame of their own.
hero.sub: Brazilian game studio since 2024. We make original titles and use games to talk about environmental preservation and accessibility.

sobre.sub: Fundev started in 2024 with a simple idea: games can entertain and, at the same time, tell stories that matter. That is why, alongside our original titles, we keep projects focused on environmental preservation and accessibility.
sobre.card1Texto: We build our own worlds, mechanics and stories, from the idea on paper to the first playable build.
sobre.card2Texto: Pantany, our social project, uses games to talk about preserving the Pantanal, one of the richest and most threatened biomes in Brazil.
sobre.card3Texto: A Aventura do Folclore is being built for autistic children in Mato Grosso, designed from the start to include.
sobre.card4Texto: We are taking our first steps beyond games, building software to order: digital solutions designed from scratch for each project.

equipe.sub: A small team, obsessed with making good games.
